items.html: And now we will explain the second aspect, which is after Adam HaRishon was created and the Holy One, blessed be He, brought him into the Garden of Eden — for then it was from the middle of the sixth day and upward, at which time holiness was necessarily added to all the worlds, as explained by us in the matter of Erev Shabbat: for from the fifth hour of Erev Shabbat the worlds begin to rise above their place, and holiness is added to them, as mentioned by us in the secret of the extra Hey stated in the verse "And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day," hinting at the fifth hour, as mentioned.
